description: This Java class 'MessageHelper' provides utility methods for working with AMQP 1.0 'Message' objects, including property accessors, payload handling, message creation, annotation management, and messaging property manipulations specific to the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: MessageHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for manipulating and extracting information from AMQP 1.0 messages within the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'device_id' application property from the message.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'tenant_id' application property from the message.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Extracts the registration assertion from the message's application properties.

methods.name: getAndRemoveRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the registration assertion from the message.

methods.name: getApplicationProperty
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve an application property of a specific type from the message.

methods.name: getJsonPayload
methods.description: Parses the message payload into a JSON object.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload data as a Buffer from the message body.

methods.name: getPayloadAsString
methods.description: Returns the payload data as a UTF-8 String.

methods.name: addTenantId
methods.description: Adds or updates the 'tenant_id' application property.

methods.name: addDeviceId
methods.description: Adds or updates the 'device_id' application property.

methods.name: addRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Adds a registration assertion token to the message.

methods.name: addCacheDirective
methods.description: Adds a cache control directive to the message's application properties.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Retrieves the cache control directive.

methods.name: setTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the Time-to-Live (TTL) header for the message.

methods.name: addTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Adds the 'ttd' property indicating time until disconnect.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Retrieves the 'ttd' property value.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the 'status' property value.

methods.name: addStatus
methods.description: Adds a status code to the message.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a custom property to the message's application properties.

methods.name: rejected
methods.description: Rejects and settles the message with an error condition.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds tenant ID, device ID, and resource info as annotations.

methods.name: addJmsVendorProperties
methods.description: Adds JMS vendor-specific properties from the message's content type and encoding.

methods.name: addAnnotation
methods.description: Adds a symbol annotation with a key-value pair.

methods.name: getAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves an annotation value by key, cast to the expected type.

methods.name: setCreationTime
methods.description: Sets the creation time of the message to current timestamp.

methods.name: isDeviceCurrentlyConnected
methods.description: Determines if a device represented by the message is currently connected based on TTD.

methods.name: setJsonPayload
methods.description: Sets the message payload from a JSON object, with content type application/json.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the message payload and content type from a Buffer.

methods.name: hasDataBody
methods.description: Checks if the message body is a Data section.

methods.name: hasAmqpValueBody
methods.description: Checks if the message body is an AmqpValue section.

methods.name: getShallowCopy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a message, including headers and body.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID for message tracking.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a new seamlessly initialized AMQP message with optional properties.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds and sets multiple properties and annotations on a message including tenant and device info.

methods.name: addDefaults
methods.description: Adds default properties such as content type and TTL from tenant and device defaults.
